headlines.title: July jobs report: Manufacturing sector is 'treading water' but still strong
headlines.summary: The US economy shed 23,000 non-farm payroll jobs in July, according to the latest report from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), which was far below economists' estimates of 80,000. UBS Global Wealth Management head of taxable fixed income strategy Leslie Falconio and Annex Wealth Management chief economist and strategist Brian Jacobsen react to the jobs data and assess how the Federal Reserve may act on interest rates based on this data.

headlines.title: US economy shed 23,000 jobs in July, economists forecasted gain of 80K
headlines.summary: The US economy shrank by 23,000 non-farm payroll jobs in July, according to the latest report from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). This was far below economists' forecasts of a gain of 80,000, while the employment rate fell to 4.1%.

headlines.title: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Mixed Growth Signals
headlines.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Friday, Aug, 7 2026 US stock futures are slightly higher this morning, with E mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.2%, as investors weigh strong services activity against softer hiring and shifting interest rate expectations. The composite PMI for July sits at 54.5, which is a broad scorecard showing private sector growth at a nine month high. However, input costs are at a 14 month high, so the cost of doing business is still rising.

headlines.title: Microsoft vs. Automatic Data Processing: Scale vs. Seasonality in Revenue
headlines.summary: Microsoft's revenue has grown every quarter in the past two years, while ADP swings between peaks and troughs -- a divergence that reveals starkly different business models.

description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. Its PEO Services segment provides HR outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. This segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
